title: Logarithmic dynamic convex-hull line intersection queries

import_provenance.original_title: Logarithmic dynamic convex-hull line intersection queries
import_provenance.original_statement: Can arbitrary planar-point insertions and deletions and queries for the two intersections of a line with their convex hull all be supported in O(log n) time using linear space? Amortized update time is permitted, but line-intersection queries should take worst-case logarithmic time.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: This remaining line-stabbing variant is not covered by the optimal bounds for extreme-point and tangent queries.
